profile.mission: To serve humanity with compassion, creating positive and sustainable change through holistic welfare programs in child education, healthcare assistance, environmental protection, women skill empowerment, and social justice across Punjab and all of India.
profile.vision: A compassionate, equitable world where every individual—irrespective of social background—has unhindered access to quality education, essential healthcare, clean water, dignified nutrition, and life-changing opportunities to thrive.
profile.description: HELPS Welfare Society is a non-governmental organization founded in 2016 in Ludhiana, Punjab. The society is registered under the Societies Registration Act XXI of 1860, operating grassroots interventions in slum child education (AABHA Centers), free rural diagnostic healthcare clinics, community nutrition (Annapoorna), and clean drinking water conservation.
